title: Volume 1 Chapter 6: Vice Captain Crusch
content: I began to question my position as the vice-captain of the Fourth Knight Order.
I had noticed that the order was slowly changing with Lord Salt's addition.
Until now, the order had been a place solely for women, and we shared Lady Rana's ideals.
We took pride in facing challenges with our own strength, without relying on men.
However, since Lord Salt became involved with the order, the atmosphere had gradually shifted.
“... Aren't Lady Freina and Lady Rana trusting him too much?”
As I held such thoughts deep within my heart, I observed the happenings within the order.
Indeed, I felt a sense of gratitude for having my life saved by him.
At first, the members had shown distrust and resistance towards him, but many who had been helped by him during expeditions were not few.
After witnessing the power of his healing magic, they gradually began to accept him.
Of course, it was remarkable that Lord Salt purified Lady Freina's poison and risked his life to save Lady Rana.
Moreover, it was true that he healed the wounds of the members.
I understood just how powerful his holy attribute magic was and how much we had been helped.
Still, somewhere in my heart, I found it difficult to fully accept him.
“Krush, you haven't been smiling much lately.”
May spoke to me in a light tone.
She was cheerful and often cared for me.
However, I couldn't respond to her innocent words.
What should I say? I didn't even know myself.
How should I face the changes within the Fourth Knight Order?
Should I change myself, or should I simply go along with this transformation?
“Krush, ever since Lord Salt came, everyone has become more cheerful!
Plus, Lady Rana has regained her smile, and all the members can fight with more confidence than before!”
May seemed to sense my inner turmoil and happily praised him.
I understood that May, having had her life saved by Lord Salt, harbored feelings beyond mere gratitude.
That was not wrong.
Rather, I understood in my head just how important he had become to us. But what should I do...?
“May... I am of no attribute, and I cannot perform like Lord Salt.”
The words slipped out of my mouth unconsciously. It was a struggle I had never shared with anyone.
“Am I truly worthy of being the vice-captain, being of no attribute and unable to use magic?”
At my words, May showed a slightly surprised expression.
She knew of the complex I carried.
I had once spoken to Lady Freina and May about how heavy a burden being of no attribute was for me.
“Krush, you are strong! Even without magic, you excel in swordsmanship! Everyone respects you!”
“But that alone...”
I didn't know if I could continue to be active in the future.
If Lord Salt hadn't helped me, I would have died fighting the White King.
I regretted having spilled my feelings to May.
I couldn't hide my weakness.
With the changes in the order, I felt as if I alone was unable to ride that wave.
Lord Salt had gained the trust of the members and was recognized by Lady Rana and Lady Freina.
Seeing him made my own powerlessness stand out even more.
“Krush, you are more worthy of being vice-captain than anyone!”
May always respected me and treated me kindly.
I knew she had her own complexes and that she always tried to be cheerful.
That was why her voice encouraged me.
Still, I couldn't completely shake off the anxiety spreading in my heart.
I didn't know my parents' faces. I had lived as an orphan in the slums since the day I was born.
Life in the slums was harsh, and I fought desperately to survive.
By the age of eight, I was already begging for food and sometimes resorted to stealing.
Every day was filled with hunger, cold, and the inability to rely on anyone.
All the children in the slums lived like that.
One day, Lady Rana was distributing food.
Her appearance in the slums looked like that of a goddess.
I stood in line for the soup she was handing out. That warmth is something I still can't forget.
Not only did my stomach feel warm, but my heart did too.
“What's your name?”
When Lady Rana asked me that, I couldn't find my voice.
I simply looked up at her, trembling. I had never been called by name before.
In the slums, having strength to survive was more important than a name.
“I see, you don't have a name. Can I call you Krush from now on?”
“Krush?”
“Yes, Krush. That will be your name.”
For the first time, I had something that belonged to me.
It was a name given to me by Lady Rana. The days that followed felt like a dream to me.
A girl in the same situation as me was taken in by Lady Rana, and I was taken in by Lady Freina.
Lady Freina's family had produced knights for generations in the Corias Territory, and I began to receive strict training, but with the help of Lady Freina and her brother, I was able to eat my fill.
Lady Rana saved me from the slums. She gave me a name. From that day, that moment, I began to walk a new life.
I met Lady Freina. She was strong and kind, like an older sister to me. Lady Freina protected, taught, and nurtured me.
It was Lady Freina who taught me swordsmanship.
However, as I grew older and learned about attributes, I realized that I couldn't use magic because I had no attribute.
Even so, I wanted to repay Lady Rana's kindness, so I worked hard on my swordsmanship.
Fortunately, I had a talent for it. Lady Freina patiently taught me as she saw my potential.
“Krush, you have a talent for the sword. Believe in yourself.”
Those words from Lady Freina became my driving force.
I couldn't use magic because of my no attribute, but I didn't want to lose to anyone with a sword.
With that thought, I dedicated myself to sword training every day.
Slowly, I began to see results, and I rose to the position of vice-captain of the Fourth Knight Order.
However, the path was not smooth.
By dedicating myself to swordsmanship, I gained recognition for my strength among the members, but I always harbored anxiety within.
Was it truly my own strength that brought me this far?
Was it because Lady Rana and Lady Freina thought of me as family that they made me vice-captain?
There were whispers among the members like that, and I too had doubts.
Am I really strong?
And am I truly of help to Lady Rana and Lady Freina?
Do they favor me?
Every time I thought that, I swung my sword and repeatedly questioned myself.
“Am I really worthy of this position?”
It wasn't just about strength.
I had to fulfill my responsibilities as a leader and as vice-captain.
I understood that was my role.
Still, the shadows of Lady Rana and Lady Freina were too large, and I couldn't hold onto the confidence that I had come this far on my own strength.
I always continued to swing my sword without fully believing in myself.
Recently, Lady Rana had changed.
I overheard my subordinates gossiping about it.
However, I couldn't understand the meaning of that change.
I understood that the atmosphere had shifted since Lord Salt's arrival, but wasn't it simply that Lady Rana had begun to trust him?
“Lady Rana has really become lively lately.”
Just like my subordinates, Lady Freina brought up the topic, and I nodded silently.
Indeed, Lady Rana's health had improved. I could see that myself.
However, I couldn't grasp the meaning of the “change” that Lady Freina and the other members spoke of.
“Indeed, she seems to be in good spirits. I think she's working more energetically than before.”
“Yeah, this is all thanks to Lord Salt.”
“Eh? How is it thanks to Lord Salt?”
“What are you saying, Krush?”
“That's right, Krush. Ever since Lord Salt saved her life, Lady Rana has changed.”
“Hmm?”
Lady Freina and May looked at me with puzzled expressions.
I understood that Lady Rana had become lively and was working energetically.
However, how was it thanks to Lord Salt?
Was it because he treated her?
What was different from before?
I couldn't understand.
Lady Rana had always been a remarkable person; wasn't she simply back to her usual self?
Wasn't that all there was to it?
“Lady Rana has been showing such a gentle expression towards Lord Salt lately.”
Lady Freina continued, smiling gently.
“That's a different face from the one she shows us. Can't you tell?”
Lady Freina explained Lady Rana's change, but I couldn't comprehend it.
At her words, I pondered for a moment. I knew that Lady Rana was treating Lord Salt kindly.
However, even if it was said to be a different face from the one she showed us, I couldn't grasp the difference.
“I don't understand what is different.”
I considered nodding along, but when I answered honestly, Lady Freina showed a slightly surprised expression.
At that moment, May let out a light laugh and patted my shoulder.
“Krush, it's because Lady Rana has fallen in love with Lord Salt!”
May's assertive words made me tilt my head.
“Love?”
I couldn't comprehend that word for a moment.
I had heard the word “love” before, but I didn't understand what kind of emotion it was.
I had never experienced love.
“That's right! Lady Rana likes Lord Salt. That's why she has a different expression than usual!”
May said that with a cheerful laugh, but I couldn't quite grasp her explanation.
Lady Rana is in love with Lord Salt?
I couldn't understand what she was saying.
“How is that different from gratitude?”
I asked without thinking.
I immediately realized that it was an unexpected question for them, as Lady Freina and May seemed momentarily speechless.
“Krush?”
May said with a wry smile, looking a bit troubled.
“Gratitude and love are completely different things.
Gratitude is a feeling of thanks, while love... is the feeling of your heart racing and wanting to be with someone!”
Racing heart? Wanting to be together? I became even more confused. I had never felt such emotions.
A racing heart? Wanting to be together? What on earth could that mean?
“Krush, have you really never been in love?”
Lady Freina asked me, but I shook my head.
I had never felt such emotions before.
For me, feeling gratitude and appreciation was everything.
I deeply appreciated Lady Rana and Lady Freina.
And I also owed Lord Salt my life. However, I had never felt anything beyond that.
“I don't understand what love is.”
Lady Freina and May fell silent for a while.
I only understood that I was missing something very important.
“Krush... love is the feeling of cherishing someone, not just gratitude.”
Lady Freina explained gently, looking at me with kind eyes.
“It's an emotion that wells up from within you. Haven't you ever felt something different when you are with Lord Salt?”
I pondered. I had never felt any special emotions when I was with Lord Salt.
I only felt gratitude for having been helped by him and that he was a trustworthy companion to me.
But was that different from love?
Something seemed off.
“I don't know what love is.”
“Hmm, it's difficult...”
May wore a slightly troubled expression.
“Krush, I'm sure there will come a time when you understand!
After all, Lord Salt is truly kind, and there will surely come a time when he moves your heart!”
May's words made me feel a bit flustered.
Moving my heart...?
Could something like that happen to me?
I still couldn't grasp it.
Will there come a time when my heart feels something, or will I remain unable to understand others' emotions forever?
However, a slight desire to know the feeling of “love” that Lady Freina and May spoke of began to sprout within me.
I still didn't know what that feeling was.
I just wanted to understand, even a little, the “something” they felt.
Lady Rana's gaze towards Lord Salt has recently changed.
I understood that it was something I couldn't comprehend.
Both Lady Freina and May said that change was “love,” but I still couldn't grasp that sensation.
To me, Lady Rana was a benefactor and a family-like existence.
And Lord Salt was also a lifesaver and someone I should respect as a knight.
I had never considered feelings beyond that.
However, Lady Rana was showing a different attitude towards Lord Salt than she had with previous men.
Lord Salt was gradually helping Lady Rana overcome her fear of men.
At first, Lady Rana was so nervous that she could only hold his hand, but now she smiled softly in front of Lord Salt and actively engaged him in conversation.
Watching that made something stir within my chest.
I couldn't understand what this feeling was. I just felt as if I was losing something.
Today, Lady Rana is with Lord Salt again.
As I swung my sword in the training grounds, strengthening my body, Lord Salt's figure suddenly came to mind.
Perhaps by being by his side, I might see something.
At that moment, May stood beside me and spoke up.
“Krush, you've been a bit absent-minded lately.”
“That's not true. I was just thinking about swordsmanship.”
“That's a lie! I can tell! Krush, you were thinking about Lord Salt. What do you think of him?”
“Lord Salt? I just feel grateful to him. He saved my life as a knight. I don't know any feelings beyond that.”
May's eyes widened slightly in surprise at my answer.
“Krush, that's not just gratitude. Your feelings for Lord Salt might be the same as what Lady Rana feels!”
“What do you mean by that?”
“Lady Rana's feelings for Lord Salt are not just gratitude. They are something more special. That is ‘love’!”
I felt confused by May's words.
“Love? I don't understand... What is it, and how should I feel...?”
“Krush, you just haven't realized it yet!
If you spend more time with Lord Salt, I'm sure you'll come to understand those feelings!”
As I listened to May's words, I felt something stirring within my heart.
Indeed, when I was with Lord Salt, I sometimes felt a sense of calm and reassurance.
If that is what they call “love”... what should I do?
If Lady Rana feels the same way towards Lord Salt...
At that moment, Lady Rana called out to me.
“Krush, I’d like to talk to you for a moment, if that's alright?”
“Yes, Lady Rana.”
Lady Rana smiled gently as she spoke.
“Actually, I would like to ask you to be Lord Salt's personal knight.”
“Me... be Lord Salt's personal knight?”
“Yes.
I want you to protect him.
Lord Salt is a necessary person for the Fourth Knight Order as a holy attribute.
I believe in your abilities.
Plus, I think you feel a sense of gratitude towards Lord Salt for saving your life.
How about repaying that gratitude by becoming his personal knight?”
Lady Rana's proposal was a gracious offer for me, and it might allow me to understand the “love” that May spoke of.
“He will surely become an indispensable presence for our knight order in the future.
However, he will still fight alone as an adventurer at times.
Therefore, I believe it is necessary for a trustworthy knight like you to be by his side.”
“Lady Rana... am I truly suited for that role?”
That's right. I am of no attribute, and do I have the power to protect Lord Salt?
“Of course, Krush.
You are the strongest, most sincere, and trustworthy knight among us.
Moreover, by being by his side, you will surely discover something new about yourself.”
As Lady Rana's words spread warmth within my heart, I felt that she believed in me.
I still didn't fully understand my feelings. However, by being by Lord Salt's side, I might begin to see something.
“I understand, Lady Rana. I will do my utmost to protect Lord Salt as his personal knight.”
“Thank you, Krush. I believe you can surely protect him.”
As I deeply nodded at Lady Rana's words, I felt a strong sense of determination welling up within me.
By being with Lord Salt, I might be able to find a new version of myself.
And perhaps one day, I will come to understand what that feeling truly is.
